reviews.text: Not sure why this business has such a low rating but Hugo did an amazing and quick job getting my truck hooked up and towed back to our yard. 10/10 would use again.
reviews.author: Bill Tetley

reviews.text: Police found my stolen motorcycle after a year. They used this towing service and it was sent to a Police Impound Lot. Customer Service was great, but the city charges you a $115.00 Vehicle Release FEE to get your stolen vehicle put.
reviews.author: Ryne Griswold
